title: Vegan Japanese Tagine
description: A flavorful and aromatic Japanese-inspired tagine made with vegan ingredients.
instructions: Heat the oil in the tagine over medium heat.
Add the onion and ginger and cook until the onion is translucent.
Add the mushrooms and cook until they release their liquid and start to brown.
Add the rice to the tagine and stir to combine with the vegetables.
Add the soy sauce and stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a simmer, then cover the tagine and cook for 20 minutes.
Turn off the heat and let the tagine rest for 10 minutes.
Fluff the rice and vegetables with a fork before serving.
